papers.title: Designing of additive auxiliary support structure in the selective laser melting considering the milling of thin-walled parts
papers.first_author_affiliation: Anhui Tuobao Additive Manufacturing Technology Company Limited, Wuhu, 241000, Anhui, China

corresponding_authors.name: Zhang Chenglin
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Anhui Tuobao Additive Manufacturing Technology Company Limited, Wuhu, 241000, Anhui, China

papers.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注选择性激光熔化中薄壁零件的辅助支撑结构设计，未涉及生物医学植入物、应力遮挡或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on support structure design for milling thin-walled parts in SLM, with no biomedical implant context, no porous structure for stress shielding, no fatigue testing, and no osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化SLM薄壁零件的辅助支撑结构以提高铣削加工质量。
summary_zh.method: 设计并优化辅助支撑结构，考虑铣削力影响。
summary_zh.result: 所提支撑结构有效减少变形，提升加工精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过铣削实验验证支撑结构效果。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize auxiliary support structures for thin-walled parts fabricated by selective laser melting to improve subsequent milling quality.
summary_en.method: Design and optimization of support structures considering milling forces and process parameters.
summary_en.result: The proposed support structure reduces deformation and enhances milling accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validation through milling experiments on SLM-fabricated thin-walled parts.

papers.title: Literature review on hydrogels in 3D skin printing: Applications, challenges and trends
papers.abstract: The following article focuses on the use of hydrogels in 3D skin printing as an alternative method to experimenting with cosmetic products on animals. It will review all aspects and concepts related to 3D skin bioprinting, from the concept of skin, creation of the 3D model, biomaterials used and their suitability, highlighting the hydrogel, types of cells and their functions, real bioprinting technologies, together with the challenges and future prospects, satisfying clinical and industrial needs. Objective: To analyze the applications, challenges and trends of hydrogel in 3D skin printing within the cosmetics industry. Method: This study is a literature review, in which data was collected from a specific area of knowledge, with the aim of analyzing the use of hydrogel in 3D skin printing, as well as its challenges and future trends. Conclusion: 3D bioprinting is a promising technology that can achieve the rapid and reliable production of biomimetic cellular skin substitutes, satisfying clinical and industrial needs.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文献综述了水凝胶在3D皮肤打印中的应用，但未涉及人工智能或机器学习在生物打印中的任何整合。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a general review on hydrogel-based skin bioprinting, with no AI/ML integration, no experimental validation, and no autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 分析水凝胶在3D皮肤打印中的潜力以替代动物实验
summary_zh.method: 系统回顾水凝胶类型、细胞来源及打印技术
summary_zh.result: 3D生物打印可快速生产仿生皮肤替代物满足临床需求

summary_en.motivation: To review the potential of hydrogels in 3D skin printing as an alternative to animal testing in the cosmetics industry.
summary_en.method: A systematic literature review covering hydrogel types, cell sources, bioprinting technologies, and clinical requirements.
summary_en.result: 3D bioprinting can rapidly produce biomimetic skin substitutes that satisfy clinical and industrial needs.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; this is a literature review.
